cues: Boehm's spiral model is driven by risk.
Each loop passes through four quadrants: set objectives, identify and resolve risks with a prototype, develop and test, then plan the next loop.
The spiral grows as cost accumulates.
It suits large, expensive, safety critical systems, but it is costly and needs real risk expertise.
